digest.component_or_area: Route reconciler differ/apply core-importer sites off vendor mappers via dependency injection
propositions: Vendor MAPPER entrypoints (_map_local_to_jira_fields, _map_jira_to_local_fields) are injected via Backend port instead of directly imported by differ modules
outbound_differ, inbound_differ, and apply_inbound receive mapper instances through dependency injection parameters that default to None and resolve via select_backend
outbound_links._RELATION_TO_JIRA_LINK is single-sourced in adapters/jira/jira_fields.py instead of being scattered across differ modules
Non-mapping vendor helpers in outbound_fields and reconcile_check remain directly imported as documented residual pending a follow-up refactor
AST assertions and positive injection tests verify that vendor MAPPER entrypoints are routed through the port and actually used by each differ
